experiments: CPLEX 12.6.1 primal/dual on 95 large NETLIB, Kennington, Mészáros and Mittelmann problems; geometric means overall and on hard subsets; 2- and 4-core runs (abstract).
positioning: Against CPLEX's default crash procedure (abstract).

method_links.note: the initial-basis procedure is evaluated against the default crash inside CPLEX 12.6.1, not inside the group's own solver

transferable: Report a component's effect by difficulty stratum (all instances; instances where the default needs over 1000 s; instances with numerical trouble) besides the overall geometric mean, measured inside the production solver against its own default (abstract).

quotes.text: The computation of an initial basis is of great importance for simplex algorithms since it determines to a large extent the number of iterations and the computational effort needed to solve linear programs.
For these problems, the proposed algorithm results in 37% reduction of the geometric mean of the execution time of CPLEX’s primal simplex algorithm.
